fichas.title: Natural and Free Ventilation
fichas.summary: Overview of natural ventilation through windows, shafts, roof ventilators, and other openings. The page compares winter and summer window airflow, describes four free-ventilation systems and workplace room groups, and gives room-depth, opening-area, and airflow recommendations. Ventilation depends on wind and thermal effects as well as building location, room depth, noise, and building structure.
